title: NexGo Ride Request Standard
description: Schema for ride request assets stored as raw (state register) assets on the Nexus blockchain. Represents the contractual ride flow between passengers and drivers in the NexGo P2P ride-hailing module. Uses Nexus Invoices API for payment.

dataFormat.description: Raw format stores the entire payload as a JSON string in the asset's data field.

self-addr.description: Queryable self-reference: a copy of this asset's own Nexus register address. The auto-assigned 'address' attribute is not filterable in register/list, so 'self-addr' lets the asset be located and linked via 'WHERE self-addr = <value>'. For raw assets it is written into the data blob when the payload is first created (written once, then immutable by convention).

pickup-lat.description: Pickup location latitude as decimal string.

pickup-lng.description: Pickup location longitude as decimal string.

passengers.description: Number of passengers for the ride.

status.description: Current state of the ride request.

driver-genesis.description: Driver's genesis hash, populated when a driver accepts the ride. Empty while requesting.

naming.description: One ride asset per ride request, local to the passenger's signature chain.

lifecycle.description: The full decentralized ride flow uses Assets for state and Invoices for payment.

steps.description: Passenger creates a ride request asset with pickup/destination coordinates and status 'requesting'.
Passenger updates the ride asset with the driver's genesis hash and status 'accepted'. Driver updates their taxi asset status to 'occupied'.
Driver creates a payment invoice specifying the ride fare. The invoice is transferred to the passenger with a conditional contract.
Payment is atomic: DEBIT (payment) + CLAIM (invoice ownership transfer) in one transaction. Ride status becomes 'paid'.
Driver updates taxi asset back to 'available'. Passenger can rate the driver via the nexgo-rating system.
If unpaid, the driver can cancel via invoices/cancel/invoice. The ride asset is updated to 'cancelled'.
